command.umbra.shadow: A shadow detached and follows your path.
command.umbra.steps: Someone is walking behind you. Don't turn around.
command.umbra.mimic: That block is not what it seems anymore.
command.umbra.mimic_failed: Look at a crafting table, bookshelf, planks, cobblestone, stone bricks, barrel, furnace, hay bale, log or ore.
command.umbra.darkness: Seeded %s blocks of living darkness (it only lives in dark, enclosed places).
command.umbra.maze: A two-storey quantum maze appeared in front of you. The entrance is on its west side.
command.umbra.home: Home set here. Mimics will move in while you are away.
command.umbra.no_maze: You are not inside a quantum maze.
message.umbra.bad_frame: The frame must be a closed rectangle of dusk stone (inside 2-6 wide, 3-8 tall).
command.umbra.rift: A rift to the Underside opened in front of you.
message.umbra.no_room: There is no room for it to appear here.
message.umbra.only_underside: This only works in the Underside.
message.umbra.freed: The Primordial Shadow is gone. Your own shadow bows to you — from now on it fights at your side.
message.umbra.compass_none: The needle spins: no quantum maze nearby.
message.umbra.compass: The maze is in '%s' — it changes its mind in %s s
journal.umbra.start.title: The first page
journal.umbra.start.text: Something is wrong with this world after dark. I will write down everything I see. If you are reading this — keep a light with you.
journal.umbra.shadow.title: My shadow
journal.umbra.shadow.text: Tonight my shadow came loose. It walks my exact path. When I stop, it catches up. Keep moving. Light slows it down.
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.title: Light against shadow
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.text: A strike with a light in hand tore the shadow apart. It left a shard — cold, heavy, humming.
journal.umbra.steps.title: Footsteps
journal.umbra.steps.text: Someone walked behind me, step for step. When I turned around, there was nobody. Do not let them get close.
journal.umbra.mimic.title: Not my table
journal.umbra.mimic.text: Something in my house was not quite right. Wrong grain, wrong sound. Hit it first — before it moves.
journal.umbra.darkness.title: Living darkness
journal.umbra.darkness.text: Deep below, the dark itself moves. It eats torches. It leaves lanterns alone. Luminite burns it away.
journal.umbra.maze.title: The maze that watches back
journal.umbra.maze.text: Walls that exist only while you look at them. When you look away, the maze thinks. A compass with echo quartz can hear what it is thinking.
journal.umbra.sanity.title: Edges of my vision
journal.umbra.sanity.text: I keep seeing figures at the edge of my eye. Sounds that should not be there. Light, sleep, food. Pills, if nothing else helps.
journal.umbra.luminite.title: Luminite
journal.umbra.luminite.text: A crystal that glows in the deep. The dark fears it. Torches that never go out, a lantern that burns the darkness away.
journal.umbra.underside.title: The Underside
journal.umbra.underside.text: Ash instead of earth, rock instead of sky. No light of its own. Everything that crawled into my world came from here.
journal.umbra.crawler.title: Crawler
journal.umbra.crawler.text: It climbs the walls and leaps from the dark. A flash of light makes it recoil.
journal.umbra.blind.title: The Blind One
journal.umbra.blind.text: It has no eyes. It hears. Sneak. Stand still. It walks right past.
journal.umbra.light_eater.title: Light Eater
journal.umbra.light_eater.text: A pale moth that drifts through walls to eat every light it finds. Luminite is too bright for it.
journal.umbra.mimicker.title: Mimicker
journal.umbra.mimicker.text: I heard a cow in the ruins. There are no cows in the Underside.
journal.umbra.shade.title: Shades
journal.umbra.shade.text: Small, weak, never alone. Bright light burns them. Sometimes they leave a shard behind.
journal.umbra.watcher.title: The Watcher
journal.umbra.watcher.text: It moved only when I looked at it. It is gone now. Its eye still feels warm.
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.title: The Queen of Mimics
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.text: She hid among her brood and in the walls of the room. I dragged her out into the light.
journal.umbra.shepherd.title: The Shepherd
journal.umbra.shepherd.text: Untouchable in his shroud of darkness, until the light burned it away.
journal.umbra.doppelganger.title: The Doppelganger
journal.umbra.doppelganger.text: It wore my armour and walked where I had been. Fighting yourself is tiring.
journal.umbra.architect.title: The Architect
journal.umbra.architect.text: The one who built the mazes. In his heart beats the abyss itself.
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.title: The Primordial Shadow
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.text: The first shadow, the one all others fall from. Only light could touch her at the end.
journal.umbra.freed.title: My shadow is mine again
journal.umbra.freed.text: It walks beside me now and strikes at anything that comes too close. The nights are quieter.
block.umbra.ward.full: The ward is full of light.
item.umbra.luminite_lantern.empty: The lantern is empty. Sneak + use with a luminite crystal.
